top_signal.title: What service business would fit this combination of skills?
top_signal.summary: I’m based in Leipzig, Germany. I studied medicine and trained in general surgery before the war forced me to relocate. I now work as a freelance interpreter, speak four languages, and run a small online shop.   Growing up, I also helped in my father’s business with office and administrative work. My strengths are organizing complicated situations, spotting practical solutions, and helping people navigate unfamiliar systems. Through interpreting, I’ve noticed that people often need help beyond the conversation itself—someone to organize the next steps and follow through.   I’d like to build a service business with low startup costs and real paying demand. Based on this background, what would you explore? If you run a small business, what problem would you consider paying someone like me to solve?       submitted by     /u/One_Atmosphere_5925       [link]       [comments]
